traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Order meets disruption. The clash of the established and the radical, the structured and the new. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Restlessness fights control; each demands attention and sabotages the other until both are satisfied at once. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for limit against disruption, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the limit/disruption form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Innovation inside structure works; an either-or stance stalls.
shadow: Fear and rigidity collides with instability for its own sake; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.

readerCopy.body: A rigid institution keeps enforcing a process that technology, staff, or public need has already made obsolete. Saturn square Uranus can make workers build unofficial workarounds while leadership tightens the same rules causing the delay. Every workaround becomes another argument about who is authorized to change the system. Stop treating the workaround as misconduct if it is the only thing keeping the work moving. Document where the official process fails and escalate the specific rule blocking a replacement.
